description: Reusable sprint decomposition patterns for game development planning. The planner selects and sequences these patterns based on project requirements.

patterns.name: Foundation
patterns.description: Project scaffold, basic rendering pipeline, player entity, input handling, camera system, and a test level to validate the loop.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Game launches, renders a test scene, player entity responds to input, camera follows player, build passes with zero errors.

patterns.name: World Generation
patterns.description: Procedural or manual level generation, fog of war or visibility system, level transitions and loading between areas.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: At least two distinct levels are generated/loaded, player can transition between them, fog of war obscures unexplored areas.

patterns.name: Character System
patterns.description: Character data model, creation flow, stat definitions, progression/leveling, and character UI screens.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Characters can be created with stats, stats display in UI, leveling up modifies stats correctly.

patterns.name: Combat System
patterns.description: Enemy entities, basic AI, pathfinding, turn-based or real-time combat resolution, XP and rewards on kill.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Player can encounter enemies, engage in combat, take and deal damage, defeat enemies yields XP, game over on player death.

patterns.name: Items & Economy
patterns.description: Item data model, inventory system, equipment slots, loot drops from enemies/chests, shop buy/sell flow.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Items can be picked up, viewed in inventory, equipped to modify stats, shops allow buying and selling with currency.

patterns.name: Abilities & Spells
patterns.description: Ability definitions, casting system, visual/mechanical effects, status conditions, cooldown and resource costs.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Characters learn abilities, abilities can be cast in combat, effects apply correctly, cooldowns prevent spam, status conditions wear off.

patterns.name: Multiplayer
patterns.description: Networking protocol selection, client/server architecture, lobby and matchmaking, game state synchronization.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Two clients can connect to a server, join a shared session, see each other's player entities, actions sync within acceptable latency.

patterns.name: AI & Personality
patterns.description: Enemy memory of player actions, adaptive difficulty, behavior trees for complex AI, nemesis or rival system.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Enemies remember past encounters, adapt tactics based on player behavior, behavior trees produce varied combat actions, named rivals persist across sessions.

patterns.name: Content Pipeline
patterns.description: Asset loading infrastructure, sprite or 3D model integration, fallback rendering for missing assets, content manifest.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Assets load from disk via manifest, sprites/models render at correct positions, missing assets show a visible fallback instead of crashing.

patterns.name: Persistence
patterns.description: Save game serialization, load game deserialization, auto-save on key events, data migration for schema changes, continue flow from main menu.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Game state saves to disk, loads restore exact state, auto-save triggers on level transitions, old saves migrate to current schema, main menu shows continue option.

patterns.name: Audio & VFX
patterns.description: Sound effect pipeline, background music with transitions, particle or VFX system, combat hit feedback, ambient environmental audio.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: Sound effects play on actions, music loops and transitions between areas, VFX render on combat hits, ambient sounds play in levels.

patterns.name: UI/UX Polish
patterns.description: Consistent UI styling, contextual help and tooltips, UI animations and transitions, accessibility options, tutorial or onboarding flow.
patterns.exit_criteria_template: All UI screens follow a consistent style guide, tooltips appear on hover/focus, transitions animate smoothly, accessibility options (text size, contrast) work, tutorial guides new players through core loop.
